title: Router Drift Control: Mitigating Off-Policy Degradation in Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21682v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training.The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where rollout--training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. Rollout Routing Replay (R3) mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. Our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. To address this, we propose Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. translated_title: 路由漂移控制：缓解混合专家强化学习中的离策略退化
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）可能因训练与推理不匹配、小批量更新以及异步训练而变为离策略。由此产生的不匹配在混合专家模型中尤为有害，因为采样与训练之间的差异可能改变路由决策并导致路由漂移。采样路由重放（R3）通过在训练阶段复用采样阶段的专家选择来缓解这种不匹配。我们的分析表明，路由重放会因丢失训练路由器选中而采样路由器未选中的专家的贡献，从而引入梯度偏差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了路由漂移控制（RDC），它将采样与训练之间的路由分歧作为离策略过时性的信号，并选择性地拒绝高漂移的响应。这种序列级过滤避免了重放引入的梯度偏差，同时保留了原生的专家选择及被保留响应所对应的学习信号。
tldr: 提出路由漂移控制（RDC）方法，将采样与训练阶段的路由分歧作为离策略过时信号，通过序列级过滤拒绝高漂移响应，在不引入梯度偏差的前提下缓解混合专家强化学习中的路由漂移与离策略退化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as an off-policy staleness signal to selectively reject high-drift responses, mitigating router drift and off-policy degradation in MoE reinforcement learning without introducing the gradient bias caused by routing replay.
